description: This file declares functions and constants related to managing radio traffic harvesting, including setting and getting harvesting status, reporting and polling periods, default configurations, and TTL for overrides.

methods.name: SetRISHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Sets the harvesting status for radio traffic scans.

methods.name: GetRISHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current harvesting status for radio traffic scans.

methods.name: SetRISReportingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the reporting period (in seconds) for radio traffic scanning.

methods.name: GetRISReportingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current reporting period for radio traffic scans.

methods.name: SetRISPollingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the polling period (in seconds) for radio traffic scans.

methods.name: GetRISPollingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current polling period for radio traffic scans.

methods.name: SetRISReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default reporting period for radio traffic scans.

methods.name: SetRISPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default polling period for radio traffic scans.

methods.name: GetRISOverrideTTL
methods.description: Gets the timeout after which the RIS intervals revert to default values.

methods.name: SetRISOverrideTTL
methods.description: Sets the timeout for enabled RIS interval overrides, enabling accelerated polling.

methods.name: GetRISOverrideTTLDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the default timeout for RIS override.

methods.name: ValidateRISPeriod
methods.description: Validates that the provided period is within an acceptable range.
